what: A bare HTTP 307 hid a renamed repository. `ship` failed at PR creation with only an opaque redirect code; the git remote already pointed at the repository's new name.
rule: Derive the repo from the git remote instead of trusting a stale flag, and explain a redirect as a possible rename.
fix: Enforcement: `ship` derives `--repo` from `git remote get-url origin` when it is omitted, warns when a given `--repo` differs from origin, and appends `(repo moved? origin is OWNER/NAME)` to any GitHub CLI error containing `HTTP 301`, `302`, `307`, or `308`. Documentation: manifest reference.
